title: I Left the Retirement-Party Registry With the Gift They Already Re-gifted

parts.text: I bought the blender on the retirement registry. At the party the blender from last year's shower was on the table with my bow. I was thirty-four, holding a receipt. The organizer said, "Blenders are a genre." I left the registry printout with the duplicate SKU highlighted and my receipt taped to the card table. They produced my blender from a closet. Last year's went back to the cousin who had re-gifted it. Genre, it turns out, has a barcode.

social.video_title: My registry blender was last year's bow — Part 1/1
social.description: SKU highlight, a closet, a genre excuse. The real blender came out. Would you have smiled at the bow?
